meta.note: This entire file is generated for this academic project, since no real data was provided for this category. It is written to be realistic and internally consistent with fee-related details already established in academic_details_parul.json (fee structure formula, caution deposit) and admissions_parul_details.json (admission cancellation/refund policy). None of this should be treated as officially confirmed university policy.

fee_payment_schedule.default_mode: Tuition fees are generally payable annually, at the start of each academic year, as reflected in the per-year tuition figures listed in academic_details_parul.json.
fee_payment_schedule.installment_option: Select programs and categories of students may request a semester-wise installment plan (two installments per year) by submitting a written request to the accounts department before the fee due date; approval is at the discretion of the accounts office.
fee_payment_schedule.hostel_fee_schedule: Hostel fees are payable annually, consistent with the 'fees have to be paid annually' guideline already documented in the hostel data.
fee_payment_schedule.due_date_pattern: Fee payment is typically due within 10-15 days of the start of each academic year/semester; students are notified via the student portal and registered email/SMS.

accepted_methods: Online payment via the student ERP portal (debit card, credit card, net banking, UPI)
Demand Draft (DD) in favor of Parul University, payable at Vadodara
Direct bank transfer / NEFT / RTGS to the university's designated fee collection account
EMI options through select partner banks/NBFCs at the time of online payment checkout, subject to bank approval and applicable interest as per the partner's terms
payment_methods.note: Cash payments are generally discouraged/not accepted at the main campus counters for security reasons; students are directed to online or DD-based payment.

late_payment_penalty.penalty_structure: A late fee penalty typically applies after the due date, commonly structured as a flat charge (e.g. ₹500-₹1,000) plus an additional per-day or per-week charge if payment remains pending beyond a further grace period.
late_payment_penalty.extended_default: Continued non-payment beyond an extended grace period (typically 30 days past due date) may result in the student being barred from attending classes/examinations until dues are cleared, and in prolonged cases, from the ERP portal/library access.
late_payment_penalty.condonation: Students facing genuine financial hardship may apply in writing to the accounts department or Dean of Students for a short extension, considered on a case-by-case basis.

refund_policy.pre_admission_withdrawal: Full refund of fees paid (minus a nominal processing charge) if withdrawal is requested before the seat-freezing/session-start deadline, as outlined in admissions_parul_details.json under 'admission_cancellation_and_withdrawal'.
refund_policy.post_admission_withdrawal: A reducing refund percentage applies the closer the withdrawal request is to the session start date, generally following UGC-mandated refund guidelines; typically no refund is available after a certain number of weeks post session-start.
refund_policy.caution_deposit: The refundable caution deposit (see academic_details_parul.json fee structure) is processed and returned separately from the tuition refund, following clearance of library, hostel, and other department dues.
refund_policy.note: This section summarizes the refund policy for financial-aid context; full withdrawal process details are documented in admissions_parul_details.json.

merit_based_scholarship.description: Awarded to students with outstanding academic performance in their qualifying examination (Class 12 for UG, graduation for PG) or in university semester results.
merit_based_scholarship.typical_criteria: Commonly tiered by percentage/CGPA brackets (e.g. 95%+, 90-94.9%, 85-89.9%), with higher brackets receiving a greater percentage waiver on tuition fee.
merit_based_scholarship.renewal: Typically renewable each year subject to maintaining a minimum required CGPA/percentage and satisfactory attendance.

sports_quota_scholarship.description: Available for students with notable district/state/national/international-level sporting achievements, verified through certificates and/or a sports trial.
sports_quota_scholarship.benefit: Partial to full tuition fee waiver depending on the level of achievement, along with sports quota seat consideration described in admissions_parul_details.json.

defense_wards_scholarship.description: Fee concession for wards (children) of serving or retired Defence/Paramilitary personnel, and in some cases for war widows/dependents, subject to submission of valid service/relationship proof.
defense_wards_scholarship.benefit: Typically a percentage-based tuition fee waiver, varying by category (serving/retired/martyred personnel dependents often receive the highest waiver tier).

economically_weaker_section_scholarship.description: Fee concession for students from economically weaker sections (EWS), based on verified family income criteria (commonly an annual family income threshold, e.g. below ₹2.5-8 lakh depending on the scheme).
economically_weaker_section_scholarship.benefit: Partial tuition fee waiver, subject to submission of a valid income certificate issued by a competent government authority.

minority_scholarship.description: Fee assistance for students belonging to recognized minority communities, often in coordination with central/state government minority scholarship schemes (e.g. Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities).
minority_scholarship.benefit: Varies based on the specific government scheme; the university typically facilitates application and documentation support rather than funding this scholarship directly.

state_government_scholarships.description: Students may be eligible for Gujarat state government scholarship schemes (e.g. for SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories, or state merit scholarships), applied for through the state's scholarship portal with university-issued bonafide/fee certificates.
state_government_scholarships.university_role: The university's accounts/scholarship cell assists with issuing required certificates and verifying enrollment status for these government-administered schemes.

scholarships.general_note: Scholarships are generally not combinable beyond a specified maximum aggregate waiver percentage; students should confirm current-year scholarship policy and application windows with the accounts/scholarship cell.

partner_banks_typical: State Bank of India (SBI) — Student Loan Scheme
Bank of Baroda — Baroda Education Loan
education_loan_tie_ups.process: Students shortlist a partner bank, submit the university-issued fee structure/admission letter along with the bank's required documents (income proof, collateral if applicable, co-applicant details), and the bank processes the loan directly; the university's accounts department assists with providing necessary fee certificates and verification letters.
education_loan_tie_ups.note: Loan approval, interest rate, and collateral requirements are entirely at the discretion of the respective bank/NBFC and are not guaranteed by the university.

sibling_and_family_discount.description: A fee concession may be available when two or more siblings, or a parent and child, are simultaneously enrolled in any program at Parul University.
sibling_and_family_discount.typical_benefit: A percentage discount (commonly in the range of 5-10%) on the tuition fee of the sibling with the lower fee structure, applied from the second enrolled family member onward.
sibling_and_family_discount.application_process: Requires submission of proof of relationship (birth certificate/family record) along with both enrollment IDs to the accounts department at the start of the academic year.

fee_receipt_and_certificate_process.fee_receipt: Automatically generated and available for download from the student ERP portal immediately after successful online payment; DD/bank transfer payments generate a receipt within 3-5 working days of fee reconciliation.
fee_receipt_and_certificate_process.bonafide_certificate: Can be requested through the ERP portal or student services office, typically issued within 3-7 working days, commonly needed for scholarship applications, bank loans, or passport/visa purposes.
fee_receipt_and_certificate_process.fee_structure_certificate: Official fee structure certificates (for loan or scholarship documentation) can be requested from the accounts department, usually issued within a similar 3-7 working day window.
